answer: Probation vesting: an address younger than 30 epochs gets rewards escrowed, released 1/30 per epoch. Two independent audits (7 random graders each, 3 flags) burn the unvested balance if either trips. Cost: to forge 100 fake addresses, an attacker defers about 15 epochs of one address's rewards each (about 1,500 total), a time-value cost, not collateral, scaling linearly with count. An honest kernel of 3 of 7 graders catches bad work. Cheapest bypass: submit plausible answers so flags stay below 3 of 7, then collect the releases; the basalt floor is the escrow delay alone.
